title: Fully Remote Digital Marketing Agency (PPC/SEO) - 100% Relocatable
description: Founded 2001, 20+ years operating history. Fully remote agency, PPC, SEO, web design. Loyal client base of 100+ accounts, no single client over 5% of revenue, ~70% recurring retainer revenue. Team of 7 W-2 employees and 2 contractors, Director of Operations manages day to day. Not owner-dependent - business operates fully during owner's absence. SBA financing. Managing partner willing to provide transition support. Untapped opportunity: more structured business development function not historically a focus.

title: Full Service Digital Marketing Agency
description: Established 2013. Charlotte NC digital marketing agency. Strong long term client relationships. 100% US-based team. 3 consecutive years of YOY sales and SDE growth (2021 $140K SDE to 2025 $197K SDE, 2024-2025 avg $253K). Seller financing available. Sellers committed to up to a year of structured transition assistance. Small office space, rent $3,000/month, weekly face time important - not fully remote. Highly competitive industry but fragmented. Growth mostly organic so far; strategic investment in marketing/business development could unlock further growth.

title: Digital Marketing Agency - Step Out of Employment and Into Ownership
description: Established year not disclosed. Louisville KY digital marketing agency, relocatable. Recurring monthly retainer revenue, diverse client base (local/regional/national, nonprofit and for-profit, professional services). Current owner focuses on client strategy/relationship management, execution supported by a small network of contractors - owner-operator model, not a fully passive/absentee setup. Low overhead, contractor-driven. 4.9 stars on Google. NDA required via broker for full CIM.
